title: Pay betting operations tax
what: Pay betting operations tax on net ACT betting revenue each financial year.

sources.title: Betting Operations Tax Act 2018 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 10(1) (current republication (R2, from 28 March 2019; Betting Operations Tax Act 2018 | Acts))
sources.quote: A betting operator is liable to pay tax (a betting operations tax) on the operator’s net ACT betting revenue for a financial year
